title: Evaluating the Reliability of CNN Models on Classifying Traffic and Road Signs using LIME
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. It evaluated the performance and reliability of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models for classifying traffic and road signs.
base_benchmarks: GTSRB - German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is on computer vision for traffic sign classification.
